dedupe_keys.name: reunion saint denis and le port ten minute urban microclimate monitoring

description: This Mendeley version 2 deposit contains ten-minute urban microclimate observations from twenty-five low-cost stations in Saint-Denis and Le Port on Réunion Island. The stations were deployed on residential buildings in neighbourhoods with contrasting urban form, and the article dates collection from October 2024 to June 2025. The current release lists separate city CSVs, station metadata, campaign and coverage tables, a variable dictionary, and an example mean-radiant-temperature and UTCI script. Mendeley states CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. The article’s licence wording combines incompatible names, so the repository value governs this draft. Measurements include air temperature, humidity, irradiance, wind and derived thermal-stress variables. This is a selected two-city campaign, not an island-wide continuous weather network. Low-cost sensor calibration, siting and temporal gaps are limitations for neighbourhood heat comparisons. A reviewer-assessed use is calibrating urban thermal-comfort simulations; model-urbanmicroclimatefoam is a related model without verified direct import. No sensor files, PDF or code were downloaded.
